items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Builds exactly the operator re-scope of 2026-11-25 (F2, F3, F5, the D8 contradiction); dropped items recorded as D72/D82.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: trunk() falls back to origin/HEAD then main on any failed or unsafe answer; a failed branch push stops the release before the PR.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Remote-supplied branch name validated by regex and passed as argv after --end-of-options; head pushes use --no-follow-tags so no tag leaves before the merge.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: 17 in-process L1 cases plus 4 real-git L2 cases, each failing on the old behaviour; 42 traces regenerated and both drivers agree.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra ls-remote per prepare; no timeout tightening (recorded as D82(3) follow-up, same as the closing verify's fetch).

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: All edited files stay under 300 lines; check_prompt_mechanics.py untouched; registry widened by one key, escape budget lowered to 0.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Run-state file gains a trunk field: producer prepare, consumers record-event, push-tag, verify; round-trip probed in test_release_p8a (prepare stores, record-event/verify read).

items.name: Docs
items.note: guide.md ch. 4.8, Appendix B and the ratchet paragraph; hooks-and-pipeline.md release CLI and run-state rows updated.
